thread:
Maya Patel: incident-bot just paged: elevated 5xx on /v1/generate (us-east-1). seeing client errors from many customers, spike started ~2265432000. kicking off bridge now. anyone oncall with me?
incident-bot: ALERT: 502 spike on /v1/generate - error_rate=18% (baseline 0.5%) - affected_region=us-east-1 - sampled_request_id=abc123def. Pager routed to Maya Patel (oncall).
Maya Patel: creating bridge -> https://meet.example/bridge/2265432100. starting triage, I'm going to flip traffic to fallback-model-v1 for new requests, will update canary policy.
Leo Ortiz: I'm available, joining bridge in 30s. Maya can you post a quick snapshot of logs and the top error?
Maya Patel: quick log tail pasted: ```
[2026-03-15T05:21:30Z] model-runtime: kernel oom in shard 2, alloc failed 0x1f4b000
[2026-03-15T05:21:31Z] proxy: upstream 10.3.4.5: error 502 read timeout
[2026-03-15T05:21:33Z] autoscale: pod restart count +3 in 2m
```
Maya Patel: symptoms look like inference runtime OOMs causing downstream 502s.
Anita Gupta: @Maya Patel do we have recent config changes to kernel/quantization or new model rollouts in the last deploy window?
Maya Patel: no model rollouts in last 6h. There was a config push to serving runtime at 2265430600 that changed per-shard cache sizing in us-east-1 (optimize cache by default). rollback candidate noted.
Olga Smirnova: I'm grabbing infra metrics now - memory on gpu-node-12 jumped at the same time as the errors. could be cache growth combined with a batch size increase.
Maya Patel: mitigation plan: 1) shift read traffic to fallback-model-v1; 2) scale up dedicated pool by +2 nodes; 3) revert cache-sizing config to previous value; 4) continue sampling logs. I'll execute 1 and 2 immediately.
Leo Ortiz: doing 1 now: `redwood route update /v1/generate --model fallback-model-v1 --weight 1.0 --region us-east-1` -> applied. 
SRE Runbook Bot: RUNBOOK: Applied traffic reroute. Next step: increase dedicated pool.
Leo Ortiz: scaling pool -> `redwood capacity scale --pool gpux-dedicated-us-east --add 2` -> scale started. ETA ~90s.
Maya Patel: rolling back config 2265430600 to previous commit (config revert). Command: `git revert --no-edit 7f9d3a --apply serving/cache-sizing` then `infra apply -e us-east-1`. starting now.
Priya Ram: do we have a short customer impact summary we can surface to comms? initial: some customers in us-east saw request failures and higher latency, degraded responses for interactive sessions; no data loss. Will draft note after mitigation.
Olga Smirnova: scale and revert both show success. memory pressure dropping on gpu-node-12. error_rate down to 0.8% in last 1m.
Maya Patel: looks stable. moving to recovery mode. logging incident timeline and evidence in the post-incident doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/2265432100-evidence.
Maya Patel: next steps: schedule postmortem; owners for RCA draft: timeline (Olga), contributing factors (Maya + Leo), mitigations and runbook changes (Anita), customer impact & comms (Priya). reviewer: Jamie Chen for peer sign-off.
Jamie Chen: I can review the draft later today. Can we target a postmortem writeup by EOD tomorrow?
Anita Gupta: noted. I'll start a runbook tweak PR for cache-sizing thresholds and add an explicit OOM autoproc to fallback earlier. Will link PR in the draft.
Leo Ortiz: collecting request traces and kernel logs; I'll attach sample traces to the doc. command I used: ```
redwood logs tail --service model-runtime --since 10m --filter "kernel oom" > /tmp/oom-samples.log
```
Maya Patel: action items (quick list): [A1] Postmortem draft by 2026-03-16 17:00 (Olga lead) [A2] Runbook PR for cache thresholds (Anita) [A3] Autoscale policy review for pod restart sensitivity (Leo) [A4] Customer impact summary + comms draft (Priya) [A5] Evidence bundle (logs/traces) uploaded and linked (Maya) [A6] Peer review and sign-off (Jamie)
Olga Smirnova: accepting A1. I'll draft timeline sections and earliest/last observed timestamps.
Priya Ram: I'll draft a short customer blurb once you share the impact numbers. we should avoid naming internal nodes.
Maya Patel: I've uploaded the logs and the sample traces to the evidence doc. Tagging here: https://docs.internal/postmortems/2265432100-evidence#attachments
SRE Runbook Bot: NOTE: New incident recorded (id=INC-2265432100). Runbook items auto-created: review-cache-sizing, add-oom-fallback, autoscale-sensitivity-audit.
Maya Patel: OK folks — thanks for fast triage. Closing the bridge in 5. Meeting notes and owners in the doc. We'll ping for draft review in #postmortems when the first draft is ready. :white_check_mark:
Jamie Chen: thanks team. I'll allocate time for review tomorrow morning. If anyone hits blockers on PRs ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Anita Gupta: will send initial PR link in the doc by EOD.
Leo Ortiz: leaving a short timeline note here for RCA: 05:20Z spike begins -> 05:21Z pager -> 05:23Z traffic reroute -> 05:25Z scale up started -> 05:27Z config revert applied -> 05:30Z error rate <1% and stable.
Maya Patel: last note: tentative severity: Sev2 (customer impact but recovery within 10m). Will mark in the postmortem doc. If legal needs the timeline intact, we'll preserve all evidence.
Olga Smirnova: adding sequence diagrams and metrics to the draft. tagging @Jamie Chen for review when done.
Priya Ram: saving a placeholder for customer comms; will wait for impact numbers.
Maya Patel: bridge closed. thanks all.
